title: Adiabatic Deformations of Black Hole Moduli: II. The Magnetic GHS Family
summary: We study the leading adiabatic response of magnetic GHS black holes in massless Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory to a prescribed exterior modulus varying slowly in advanced time. In ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates with the exact areal radius, we derive the time-dependent spherical equations and expand about a slowly evolving instantaneous static GHS representative, keeping its horizon distinct from the exact dynamical marginal horizon.
